mechanism: Dual ACE inhibition and neprilysin inhibition causes excessive angiotensin II suppression and potentiation of natriuretic peptides, leading to severe hypotension, hyperkalemia, and acute kidney injury.
action: This combination is contraindicated; lisinopril must be discontinued before initiating sacubitril/valsartan (a combined neprilysin inhibitor and ARB) due to risk of profound hypotension and angioedema.
